{{Quote|I remember a time when Jedi were not generals, but peacekeepers.|Satine Kryze|audio=NotGeneralsButPeacekeepers.flac|<ref name="VoT" />}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were sent to escort [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and several [[Senator/Legends|senators]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] so the Duchess could defend herself against the claims that she was in league with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the trip, the Duchess's ship, the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], was '''attacked''' by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], which was aided by the Confederacy. As [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] searched the ship for anything that might threaten the Duchess, they were attacked by numerous [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]] and [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killers]], which killed the clones [[Mixer/Legends|Mixer]] and [[Redeye/Legends|Redeye]]. Though the probes were eventually defeated, Skywalker and Kenobi had strong suspicions that there was a traitor aboard the ship. Kenobi used one of the probe killers to reveal the traitor, by presenting the probe to each of the four senators in turn. While the probe was hostile toward three of them, but remained calm around [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]], Kenobi revealed Merrik to be the traitor. Escaping Kenobi's attempted arrest, Merrik contacted [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. Vizsla sent three [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] filled with [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] to attack the ''Coronet'' so Merrik could escape with Kryze as his hostage. Skywalker, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], and [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Satine's guard]] held off the droids, while Kenobi pursued Merrik through the ship. After defeating the droids, Skywalker killed Merrik, who had threatened to destroy the ship and everyone aboard. The ''Coronet'' made it safely to Coruscant, where several more [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|assassination attempts]] were made against the Duchess.

==Prelude==
[[File:Vizsla_toasts_Satine.png|thumb|left|180px|Governor Vizsla toasts Duchess Satine's good fortune]]
{{Quote|But why target me?''"<br />"''You lead the Council of Neutral Systems, thus you threaten the Separatists' goals. Take it as a compliment. Someone very powerful is working toward your downfall.|Satine Kryze and Pre Vizsla|audio=YouLeadCONS-TMP.flac|<ref name="TMP">{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}</ref>}}
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Voyage of Temptation Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], rumors began spreading that [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], the leader of the [[Council of Neutral Systems/Legends|Council of Neutral Systems]], was in league with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="VoT" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]<ref name="obidb" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to ascertain the truth. An [[Attack on the Memorial Shrine/Legends|assassination attempt]] against the Duchess on the world led Kenobi and Kryze to [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. There, Kenobi investigated the [[Death Watch hideout]], and uncovered a plot by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Concordia&mdash;and secretly the leader of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]&mdash;to overthrow the Duchess and enter the war on the side of the Confederacy. After Kenobi and Kryze narrowly escaped a [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|confrontation]] with Vizsla and other members of the Death Watch,<ref name="TMP" /> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="anidb" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], including [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]<ref name="VoT" />&mdash;nicknamed "Cody"<ref name="codydb" /> and "Rex,"<ref name="rexdb" /> respectively&mdash;"[[Mixer/Legends|Mixer]]," and "[[Redeye/Legends|Redeye]]," were sent to Mandalore to help Kenobi escort the Duchess to Coruscant, where she could defend herself against the accusations against her in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="VoT" />

==The skirmish==
===The probes===
{{Quote|There's assassin probes down here!|Anakin Skywalker|audio=AssassinProbes.flac|<ref name="VoT" />}}
Aboard the Duchess's ship, the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were ordered to search for any sign of suspicious activity. As they scoured the dark rooms of the cargo hold, the clone trooper Redeye was attacked by an [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probe]]. The clone Mixer became suspicious when he tried to contact his comrade via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and received no response. However, before he could discover what had happened, he was also attacked by a probe.<ref name="VoT" />

Elsewhere in the cargo hold, [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]<ref name="r2db">{{DB|droid|r2d2|R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)}}</ref> [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] also searched the ship with his sensors, which told him something was amiss. In response to R2's worry and the disappearance of two clone troopers,<ref name="VoT" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]<ref name="rexdb" /> Rex contacted Skywalker and Kenobi via comlink and explained the situation. While Kenobi joined Duchess Kryze and the [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] for a meal, Skywalker joined the clones. In their search for Mixer and Redeye, Skywalker and the clones discovered a cargo crate with the cover open and the contents missing. Becoming increasingly suspicious, Skywalker and the clones searched the area to find what might have been inside.<ref name="VoT" />

[[File:Assassin_probe.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Kryze's meal is interrupted by an assassin probe.]]

As the search continued, Skywalker noticed Redeye slowly walking toward him. However, when Skywalker asked where Redeye had been, he received no response. Skywalker then noticed an assassin probe behind the clone, and ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The droid tossed the corpse of the clone at Skywalker, though the Jedi managed to dodge the attack. He then [[Cho mok/Legends|severed some of the droid's legs]], and the clones finished it off with their [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifles]].<ref name="VoT" />

Skywalker noticed another probe making its way toward the [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]], and warned Kenobi, who was dining with the Duchess and the Senators, via comlink. Satine's guards attempted to close the lift before the droid could enter the room, but they were too slow, and the assassin probe threw the guards aside, leaping onto the dinner table. Kenobi ignited his lightsaber and severed two of the droid's legs before destroying it with a [[Shiak|stab]] through its head.<ref name="VoT" />

Suspecting that there may be another assassin probe left in the cargo room, Skywalker ordered the clones to continue their search.<ref name="VoT" /> When [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]<ref name="codydb" /> Cody noticed that the destroyed assassin droid behind Skywalker was releasing several [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killers]] from its innards, he shouted out a warning. Skywalker and the clones began to fight the probe killers off, while R2-D2 used his [[Electro-shock prod/Legends|droid shock arm]] against the probes.<ref name="VoT" />

The defunct droid in the dining area also released probe killers. Kryze, armed with a [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|deactivator hold-out pistol]], helped Kenobi fight the machines. Soon most of the probes in both areas were destroyed, but Skywalker and Kenobi both knew there was a traitor aboard the ship, and they were determined to discover who it was.<ref name="VoT" />

===Merrik's betrayal===
{{Quote|I'll take care of this, Obi-Wan. You, go find your girlfriend.''"<br />"''Right&hellip; No! Anakin! She's not my&hellip;|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, about Satine Kryze|audio=GoFindYourGirlfriend.flac|<ref name="VoT" />}}
[[File:Satinegunpoint.png|thumb|left|220px|Kryze holds Merrik at gunpoint.]]

Skywalker retrieved the ship's [[Cargo manifest/Legends|cargo manifest]] from a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] to discover how the probes had gotten aboard the ship. Unfortunately, the manifest did not give a name, but it did have a Senate stamp, which meant that one of the four senators aboard the ship was responsible for the probes.<ref name="VoT" /><ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode213.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>

In the dining area, Kenobi discovered one of the smaller probe killers left alive, and decided that instead of destroying it, he would use it to discover the identity of the traitor. When he presented to the probe each of the Senators in turn, the probe appeared hostile toward three of them, but remained calm when near Tal Merrik. But before Kenobi could arrest him, Merrik knocked the probe out of Obi-Wan's hand. In the confusion that followed, Merrik took Duchess Kryze by the throat and held a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] to her head. He fled the scene as Kenobi destroyed the probe, which was attacking Senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]].<ref name="VoT" />

Meanwhile, Skywalker and the clones continued to search the cargo hold for any remaining probes. A probe killer attacked Cody and Rex, but it was destroyed by Artoo's shock arm. Then, the last of the larger assassin probes appeared and lunged at Rex. It landed on top of the clone, who held its razor-sharp arms away from him. He managed to kick the droid toward the wall, and Skywalker [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber throw|threw]] his lightsaber at it. The droid fell to the ground as Rex climbed atop it and fired his blaster pistols into its head, destroying the droid and the probe killers inside it.<ref name="VoT" />

Merrik, with Kryze as his hostage, reached the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Killing the crew and pulling the ship out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Merrik contacted Pre Vizsla via hologram, who sent three [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] filled with B2 super battle droids toward the ''Coronet''. As the boarding ships connected to the ''Coronet''{{'s}} [[Hull/Legends|hull]], Skywalker, the clones, and Satine's guards rushed to meet the droids, while Kenobi went to find Merrik and Kryze.<ref name="VoT" />

Kenobi found Merrik on the ''Coronet''{{'s}} bridge and attempted to arrest him, but Merrik had a remote, which was set to detonate the explosives Merrik had wired to the ship's engines. He warned Kenobi to stay back, or he would push the button and everyone aboard the ship would die. Kryze begged Kenobi to stand his ground; she would rather be captured than see everyone aboard killed. Merrik began to leave the bridge, and Kenobi followed at a distance as Merrik made his way to one of the boarding craft.<ref name="VoT" />

[[File:TalMerrickFate.png|thumb|right|220px|Merrik meets his fate upon Skywalker's lightsaber.]]
Elsewhere, the fight against the super battle droids continued. Skywalker, the clones, and Satine's guards managed to kill all but the last three, which Skywalker destroyed by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force pushing]] them against the wall. He then set off to find Kenobi.<ref name="VoT" />

Merrik reached the boarding craft, but before he could escape with Kryze, the Duchess stepped on his foot and was able to retrieve his blaster, which she pointed at his head. Merrik, knowing that Kryze's pacifist views would prevent her from pulling the trigger, promised he would blow the ship up once he was away. He taunted Kenobi, who he said could not kill him for fear of what Kryze might think. But before Merrik could make his escape, Skywalker arrived and ignited his lightsaber through the Senator's back, instantly killing him.<ref name="VoT" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I'm still not sure about the beard.''"<br />"''Why? What's wrong with it?''"<br />"''It hides too much of your handsome face.|Duchess Satine and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=StillNotSure-VoT.flac|<ref name="VoT" />}}
The ''Coronet'' finally reached Coruscant in one piece. The ship's passengers were greeted by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who praised the Jedi for their bravery.<ref name="VoT" /> Once on Coruscant, several more [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|assassination attempts]] were made against the Duchess. In a session of Congress, the Senate was shown a hologram of [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]], who asked for assistance from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the fight against the Death Watch. Persuaded by Jerec's plea, the Senate voted to occupy the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], much to Kryze's dismay. However, the Duchess, with the help of Kenobi and [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]], was able to prove that the hologram had been doctored, and the Senate rescinded their vote.<ref name="DoM" />

==Behind the scenes==
This skirmish first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Voyage of Temptation]]," the thirteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the series, which aired on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[February 5]], [[2010]]. While "Voyage of Temptation" is the second episode of the Mandalorian story arc, it was the first to be produced."<ref name="EpGuide" />
